5. Data Security
TechNova handles highly sensitive intellectual property and client data. All data at
rest on company-issued laptops is fully encrypted using standard disk encryption

Employees are strictly forbidden from uploading corporate data to unauthorized public
cloud storage services (e.g., personal Google Drive, Dropbox) or generative AI tools

(Public, Internal, Confidential, Restricted) must be applied to all documents.
